title: Opening and Activating Physician Client Accounts
content:
Physician Client Accounts are opened for one location of an ordering organization and go live only once credentialing is complete.

## Provisions

1. **Who may hold an account.** A client account can be opened only for a customer profile whose customer type is client organization. The profile on record decides this before the account is opened, matched by the organization's customer reference number; a patient profile cannot hold a client account.
2. **Account class.** The account class is chosen from the organization type and its expected monthly client-billed volume against the class's minimum monthly client-billed volume, and the class is reviewed at the interval of the class's volume review cycle, a number of calendar months.
3. **Activation.** Activation needs every document on the class's list of credentialing documents, including a business associate agreement where the class requires one on file, and is completed within the class's number of setup business days of receiving them.
4. **Lapse of setup.** A setup not completed within the class's setup limit in calendar days from the opening date is closed.
5. **Ordering interfaces.** An EHR interface is built only where the class offers one and the location sends at least the class's number of requisitions a month needed for an interface; paper requisitions are accepted only where the class allows them.

## Status of a new account

| Status | How the account reaches it | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| Pending setup | The organization applies for an account for one location; the account is opened with its client account number, the location name as registered, how the location will order, and the opening date. | Setup is under way. |
| Active | Activated by the laboratory once credentialing is complete and the signed client agreement is on file; the activation date is recorded. | The account can order and be billed. |
| Closed | Closed automatically when setup was not completed within the setup limit; the closing date is recorded. | The account no longer operates. |

A change in how the location orders (its ordering interface) is recorded on the account as a change of interface.

## Interface eligibility at a glance

| The class offers an EHR interface | The location's monthly requisitions reach the class figure | EHR interface |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The conditions for building one are met |
| Yes | No | Not built |
| No | Either | Not built |

| The class allows paper requisitions | Paper requisitions |
|---|---|
| Yes | Accepted |
| No | Not accepted |

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A location sending 300 requisitions a month, in a class that offers an interface at 250 requisitions a month, meets the interface conditions; the same location in a class that requires 400 does not.
